system.description:
The Cappadocian selects one of her target's limbs (or the head) and induces internal atrophy and decay. The limb immediately becomes useless and will rot and fall off gruesomely within days. Applied to the head, this power is universally fatal to mortals.

System: The vampire must touch her target and spend a Willpower Trait, then win a Physical Challenge (retest with Medicine) against the target's Willpower. Success causes the chosen limb to wither and eventually fall away; a botch instead afflicts the Cappadocian's own limb. If used on a vampire, the effect wears off when she next rises, though a vampire whose head is targeted may not use Disciplines or feed until then.
system.source: Clanbook: Cappadocian, Chapter Three: Observations and Conclusions
